A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same Panel2Patch research. The complete main texts, equations, tables, figures, and supplementary material are readable and support reliable comparison after matching relocated content and renumbered sections.

before.justification: v1 reports original retrieval and zero-shot classification results, training ablations in Tables 2–5, and supplementary empirical comparisons.

after.justification: v2 retains the original retrieval, classification, ablation, and supplementary results, including Tables 2–5 and Figure 10.

M1.justification: Section 3 retains the same panel decomposition, marker/caption-guided region mining, hierarchical alignment losses, ROI pooling, and alternating training. The supplementary prompts and processing procedures are also unchanged.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same Biomedica-derived pretraining corpus, held-out PubMed retrieval sets, and biomedical classification and cell-imaging benchmarks. No dataset, specialty, or task scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Table 2 retains OPEN CLIP, PMC-CLIP, MedSigLIP, BioMedCLIP, and BMC-CLIP. Table 3 retains its classification comparator set, including BMC-LongCLIP, and Figure 10 retains the Biomedica comparison.

E3.justification: Reported training budgets, retrieval metrics, disjoint 2025 PubMed evaluation construction, classification protocols, and ablation sample sizes are unchanged. The supplementary evaluation section is renumbered from Section 9 to Section 10.

E4.justification: The supervision-level and alternating-training ablations in Tables 4–5 are identical. Supplementary box-processing examples, model-capacity comparisons for panel parsing, and region-mining examples in Figures 7–9 are retained unchanged.

E5.justification: Uncertainty reporting is unchanged, including the error bars in Figure 10. No new repeated-run or seed information, uncertainty-estimation procedure, or significance test appears.

E6.justification: Numerical entries in Tables 2–7 and the graphical results are unchanged. For example, Table 2 retains the proposed model's single-panel I2T R@1 of 36.60%, and Table 3 retains its classification average of 50.25. Qualitative findings also match.

T1.justification: Section 3.3 retains the same embedding definitions, aggregation equations, positive-pair sets, and contrastive-loss expressions. No formal assumption, derivation, theorem, or proof is introduced or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about hierarchical supervision, zoom-in pretraining, improved biomedical representations, and data efficiency, including the claim of using 60% less data.

C2.justification: Interpretations concerning reduced hallucinations through marker guidance, improved grounding through hierarchical supervision, and reduced forgetting through alternating training are unchanged. No substantive limitation or applicability qualification is added.

D1.justification: The LVLM prompts and configuration, box-processing thresholds, optimizer settings, hardware and compute costs, and data-processing instructions remain unchanged. No code or data access information is added or revised.

R1.justification: The same 45 references and related-work arguments are retained. Changes to citation back-reference page numbers follow pagination changes and do not alter research positioning.

P1.justification: v2 expands author affiliations and adds Section 6, Acknowledgment, covering funding and institutional support. Supplementary Sections 6–9 become Sections 7–10, with updated cross-references. The scientific prose is otherwise unchanged.

P2.justification: Table 1 moves from PDF page 2 to page 3, Figure 2 is reduced in size, and the expanded author block causes text reflow. The conclusion now ends on page 8, while page 9 contains acknowledgments. Figure and table content is retained.

improvement.justification: v2 makes institutional and funding attribution more complete, while the smaller Figure 2 modestly reduces its readability. These limited editorial changes leave the methods, experimental evidence, explanations, and reproducibility information unchanged, producing no meaningful net difference in overall paper quality.
